items.label: Compatibility
items.value: This keyboard case is only compatible with iPad 10.9 inch 10th Generation (models A2696, A2757, A2777) and iPad 11th 2025 A16 Chip (models A3354, A3355, A3356).

items.label: Easy-Set Magnetic Stand
items.value: you can attach your iPad 10th generation to the keyboard back case magnetically, Set the floating cantilever stand with one smooth motion, and transform your iPad into a highly performant and easy-to-use laptop within a second! Which is perfect for traveling, business, and school.

items.label: Multi-Touch Trackpad
items.value: It with a built-in precision trackpad that can quickly and easily navigate your iPad. Full multi-touch gesture support lets you redefine productivity by allowing you to edit documents, build presentations, and browse the web with unparalleled speed. It also with a full row of iPadOS shortcuts, to adjust brightness levels, volume or change your music with one tap.

items.label: Enhanced Protection
items.value: The keyboard case is composed of a sturdy keyboard base and synthetic vegan leather case which offers unmatched protection to the iPad during use, on the go or in case of accidental knocks/falls. The strength and structural integrity of the keyboard case makes it ideal for any environment.

items.label: Long-Lasting Battery
items.value: The 750mAh battery and ultra-efficient design let you work longer on a single charge. Work daily for 3 months or nightly for 2 weeks on a single charge then recharge quickly with convenient USB-C charging
